1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with clear spacing between lines, labels, and fields.

2.why: No italics or all-caps text appear, and blocks are short, though identical error banners stack into a repeated wall of text by step 8.

3.why: Content fits the narrow mobile viewport and remains readable, though the accumulating banners make the page very long.

4.why: Instructions are brief and plain, e.g. 'Sign in to start your security setup.'

5.why: The email field shows 'Example: marcus@example.com' directly beneath the input.

6.why: No long prose blocks are required to proceed; the longest text is the two-line demo credentials note, though eight repeated banners accumulate.

7.why: No codes, secrets, or copy-to-clipboard controls appear anywhere in the eight screenshots.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is shown on any screen.

9.why: The hint 'Use your saved password' suggests password-manager support, but no autofill behaviour is demonstrated and the sign-in never succeeds.

10.why: The header shows 'Step 1 of 4 · Sign in' and a large blue 'Sign in' button dominates the screen.

11.why: Only one primary action ('Sign in') is presented on the screen across all steps.

12.why: Each attempt produces a banner, but it only repeats 'Check your email and password, then try again.' and duplicates pile up without the flow ever confirming progress.

13.why: Retries are clearly possible with no lockout after many attempts, but no reveal/hide password toggle or code re-request option is visible.

14.why: The message is non-blaming and suggests a fix (check and retry), but it does not identify which credential is wrong and the identical banners keep stacking.

15.why: No countdowns, timers, or auto-updating elements appear on any screen, though no code-entry step is reached to confirm generous entry time.
